history.summary: First-sight UI/flow, the two-lock ledger and safe import, required accessibility/offline behavior, and mandatory Playwright coverage are missing; assess still colours greedily during play.

A fresh ledger always rejects the first claim as stale_generation; practice switching, result painting, input release metadata, repertoire isolation, backup edge cases, accessibility, and mandatory Playwright/offline coverage remain incorrect or missing.

Core first-sight flow now runs, but ledger idempotency and stale-import generation checks fail; practice/pending-save lifecycle, visible result symbols, responsive focus, exact unit proofs, and mandatory browser/offline suites remain incomplete.

Generator profiles allow fourths instead of thirds; newer ledgers are overwritten; result semantics/contrast and mandatory recorder, ledger, backup, UI, and full offline browser suites remain incomplete.
All MVP acceptance criteria pass, including the iteration-4 regressions, complete browser/offline coverage, unchanged goldens, and a headed-Chrome first-attempt reload journey.
Mixed keyboard/MIDI ownership is closed incorrectly on focus loss; completed results do not relocalize; mandatory flow, ledger, accessibility, and pending-save Playwright cases remain incomplete.
Mixed-source attempts never set mixedInput; audio suspension leaves first-sight active; note names remain visible; ledger errors leak untranslated codes; the non-greedy browser test sends no input.

All M0-M10 criteria pass, including mixedInput persistence, audio/BLE interruption, assistance suppression, localized ledger failures, real-input non-greedy coverage, offline matrices, and the headed reload journey.
Iteration-7 regressions are fixed and all gates pass, but restViolations incorrectly counts extras inside neighboring note association windows, contrary to the exact evaluator specification.
Neighbor-window rest handling works for default close repeats, but the evaluator allows association windows above the required 250 ms maximum and the tests omit the 45%-narrowed rest-window case.

The evaluator cap and runtime behavior are correct, but the 135/165 ms regression inputs are matched notes rather than genuine extras, so the exact close-repeat rest-boundary coverage is still missing.

All M0-M10 criteria and prior regressions pass; close-repeat boundary cases now prove genuine extras with correct TP/FN/FP and rest-violation results, and the exact full gate and manual reload journey succeed.
AC2 is fixed, but an async practice-switch race makes Playwright flaky and an interrupted ledger wait can start a ghost practice run.
